events.title: Cash Bingo — The Lenches Club
events.body: Cash bingo at The Lenches Club on Friday 30 October, 7.30pm to 11pm, tickets from 7.15pm, eyes down at 8pm. £5 per bingo book, £5 cash flyer, bonus ball £1 per square. Over 18s only.

events.title: Christmas Market — Spetchley Park Gardens
events.body: Spetchley Park Gardens will host a free Christmas market on 14 and 15 November, with a mix of indoor and outdoor stalls.

notices.title: Tennis Club Tour to Porto — The Lenches Tennis Club
notices.body: Sixteen men from The Lenches Tennis Club enjoyed a tour to Porto, combining tennis with a trip up the Douro Valley and a river boat trip. Next tours planned to Edgbaston and possibly for the Ladies section in spring.

notices.title: Peter Pandemonium — GLADS Production
notices.body: The Great Lenches Amateur Dramatics Society performed their comedy version of Peter Pan, Peter Pandemonium, to full houses over two nights. Anyone interested in joining future productions can contact Simon Badger at the Lenches Lakes.

notices.title: Road Closure — Ab Lench Road, Church Lench
notices.body: Ab Lench Road, Church Lench will be closed on Monday 26 October for Openreach streetworks, with a diversion route in place via Main Street.

notices.title: Road Closure — Badgers Hill to Handgate Lane, Sheriffs Lench
notices.body: Badgers Hill to Handgate Lane, Sheriffs Lench, closed from Tuesday 27 October to Sunday 29 November for Severn Trent Water works, with a diversion via Handgate Lane, Church Lench.

notices.title: Brookdale, Harvington — water works
notices.body: Severn Trent Water works at Brookdale, Harvington, from Wednesday 21 to Friday 23 October; no carriageway incursion expected and delays are unlikely.

notices.title: Hughes Close, Harvington — Openreach works
notices.body: Openreach works at Hughes Close, Harvington, from Thursday 22 to Monday 26 October; some carriageway incursion but delays are unlikely.

notices.title: Leys Road, Harvington — water works
notices.body: Severn Trent Water works at Leys Road, Harvington, from Wednesday 21 to Friday 23 October; no carriageway incursion expected.

notices.title: Stratford Road, Harvington — water works
notices.body: Severn Trent Water works at Stratford Road, Harvington, from Wednesday 21 to Friday 23 October; some carriageway incursion but delays unlikely.

notices.title: Landline switch-off to affect parts of Worcestershire
notices.body: Openreach has named eight Worcestershire areas affected by a nationwide shift from old copper landlines to full fibre broadband, as the UK moves towards digital phone services.

notices.title: Police appeal after night burglaries in Inkberrow area
notices.body: Police have issued an appeal for information following a series of burglaries in Inkberrow and Bradley Green, in which windows were smashed to gain entry overnight.
